doc.title: Scott Jimmy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Keeping expectations down
summary: He says he fights getting excited after many broken hopes.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Life philosophy: faith, karma and how to live

blocks.x: . . . and you always hope that this is it.
Right. That’s what I’m saying. But you had been excited before and been disappointed, so you . . .
There you go. You’re fighting to keep from getting excited over things.
Knowing that your heart might be broken, and you don’t want to deal with another broken heart.
So many times. So many times.
You’ve got the idea. You’re right dead-on the idea.
You want to keep your expectations down, because you don’t want your heart broken again.
